claim_type: Unfair dismissal; disability discrimination (s15 and s20 EqA 2010)
summary: Dismissed on capability grounds after 11 months' absence with a musculoskeletal condition. No occupational health referral obtained at any stage. No reasonable adjustments considered. Two return-to-work proposals from the employee not responded to.
narwhal_position: Narwhal maintains the dismissal was a fair capability dismissal following a reasonable procedure
notes: Marchmont Sayers: the absence of any OH referral in an 11-month absence is close to determinative on the s20 claim. Settlement recommended. Narwhal has not made an offer.

summary: Female quality engineer claims like work with a named male comparator at the same grade paid GBP 6,400 more. Narwhal has no job evaluation scheme and no equal pay audit.
narwhal_position: Narwhal asserts a material factor defence based on the comparator's prior experience
advisers_prospects_of_defence: UNCERTAIN - cannot assess without a job evaluation exercise

summary: Employee dismissed during certified sick leave. Polish Labour Code Article 41 prohibits termination during justified absence.
narwhal_position: Narwhal asserts the absence had exceeded the protected period
notes: Kaczmarek Wiszniewski: the protected period calculation used by Narwhal is wrong. Reinstatement is the primary remedy in Poland and is a realistic outcome. Exposure stated in GBP at PLN 5.12. Reinstatement would also breach the collective agreement consultation obligations if handled poorly a second time.

claim_type: Employment status; unlawful deduction from wages; holiday pay
summary: Former self-employed field engineer claims worker or employee status over a 6-year engagement, seeking holiday pay and pension arrears.
notes: THE ONE THAT MATTERS. This is a single claimant but the determination would apply to the whole population of 34 contractors and would establish the fact pattern for an HMRC status enquiry. Marchmont Sayers assess prospects of defending as poor on the substitution and control points. If this reaches a determination before completion the IR35 exposure at UNI-DD-HR-001 s.5 crystallises. ACAS conciliation period expires 2026-05-23.
